item.title: materials and info
item.description: I am a statistician and my research is focused on the methodological and computational aspects of data analysis. The best feeling is when I can use my knowledge to solve practical and real problems. I am currently working on latent variable models, unsupervised classification and model-based composite indicators. ongoing projects software seminars and talks events supervisions and teaching

item.title: supervisions and teaching
item.description: supervisions from september, I will be supervising - together with Olga Kuryatnikova and Patrick J.F. Groenen - the PhD project of Leon Czarnecki I am currently co-supervising - together with Olga Kuryatnikova and Wilco van den Heuvel - the PhD project of Marten Soer. The project sits at the intersection of Statistics and Operations Research, focusing on reducing computation via structural insights, applying advanced optimization methods, improving robustness to noise and unseen data, and enabling parameter constraints
